import html # Pre‑defined HTML template with placeholders. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}

{event_description}
{additional_notes}
""" def generate_event_html(title: str, description: str, date: str, extra_notes: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of an event invitation. Returns ------- str A string of sanitized HTML that safely renders the event invitation. Notes ----- All user‑supplied content is escaped using html.escape to mitigate XSS (CWE‑79). ") safe_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(extra_notes, quote=True).replace("\n", "
